method: Built-in image_gen: five photorealistic scenes composed with actual app screenshots, plus two stock-portrait edits.
note: Illustrative AI-generated/edited people and environments, not actual customer testimonials. Each display uses the supplied matching feature screenshot as its reference.

images.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create a premium, photorealistic landscape 3:2 product lifestyle photograph for the TypingEase website. Image 1 is a licensed stock person reference: preserve this woman's recognizable face, hair and coral blouse, change her pose naturally to seated working at a laptop. Image 2 is the actual TypingEase app screenshot to place accurately inside the laptop screen, preserving its green/white UI, logo and keyboard. Camera views laptop from over her shoulder at a gentle side angle, with her face in profile visible on the left third and the laptop screen large on right two-thirds, not a rear view of the lid. Laptop display must visibly show image 2, no invented dashboards. Intimate real office moment, dark forest-green out-of-focus office background, walnut desk, soft window light on face and screen, rich dark tones surrounding the luminous white screen for strong contrast at thumbnail scale. Real photographic skin and hands, natural anatomy. Person and laptop occupy the frame, no blank advertising space, no overlay captions, no extra logos, no testimonial claim. Export high quality PNG.
